why.en: curl can report how long the TCP connect took, which is one round trip to the server.
why.hinglish: curl bata sakta hai ki TCP connect mein kitna time laga, jo server tak ek round trip hota hai.

expect.en: A line like 'connect: 0.021s'. The value depends on your distance to the server; it is roughly one round trip, as in step 1.
expect.hinglish: 'connect: 0.021s' jaisi line. Value server se tumhari doori par depend karti hai; yeh lagbhag ek round trip hai, jaise step 1 mein.

title.en: See your open TCP connections and their states
title.hinglish: Apne open TCP connections aur unke states dekho

why.en: Shows ESTABLISHED, LISTEN and TIME-WAIT connections on your own machine.
why.hinglish: Apni machine par ESTABLISHED, LISTEN aur TIME-WAIT connections dikhata hai.

expect.en: A table of local and remote addresses with a state column. The entries differ on every machine; on macOS use netstat -an -p tcp.
expect.hinglish: Local aur remote addresses ki table, state column ke saath. Entries har machine par alag hoti hain; macOS par netstat -an -p tcp use karo.

why.en: Connecting to a closed port on your own machine shows the RST behaviour from the second scenario.
why.hinglish: Apni hi machine ke closed port se connect karne par doosre scenario wala RST behaviour dikhta hai.

expect.en: Windows reports TcpTestSucceeded : False; nc reports 'Connection refused'. This assumes nothing of yours listens on port 8080.
expect.hinglish: Windows TcpTestSucceeded : False batata hai; nc 'Connection refused' batata hai. Maan ke chal rahe hain ki tumhari koi cheez port 8080 par listen nahi kar rahi.

title.en: Find the handshake and the lost segment
title.hinglish: Handshake aur kho gaya segment dhoondo

why.en: Open the .pcap in Wireshark and use these filters.
why.hinglish: .pcap Wireshark mein kholo aur yeh filters lagao.

expect.en: The SYN and SYN-ACK packets, plus the duplicate ACK and the retransmitted segment in the first scenario.
expect.hinglish: SYN aur SYN-ACK packets, aur pehle scenario mein duplicate ACK aur dobara bheja gaya segment.
